scope: M1 only: five policy/reader/package/test files and two author reports listed in binding.json. No M2 store/CLI, M3 installation/hooks, M4 product acceptance.
reviewerIdentityNote: Fresh independent requested GPT-6 Astra high task; backend serving identity not independently observable.

checks.suppliedTests: Independently rerun 74/74, exit 0; includes containment and actual linked-worktree tests.
checks.positivePath: Author genuine loan campaign plus synthetic integer budget: ALLOWED, empty missingEvidence. This verifies reachability, not current resource authority.
checks.probes: 24 retained observations: baseline permits, 22 mutations permit, blocked prerequisite control denies. Several metadata mutations are diagnostic contradictions rather than proof that a new review must always be forbidden.
checks.rootEvidence: root-positive-path-probes2.json reported by root; not independently rerun here.

findings.title: Requested action is not bound to candidate, scope or evidence profile
findings.repro: positive-author-integer-budget allows. action-wrong-candidate, action-wrong-evidence-profile, action-unrelated-capability and stage-wrong-candidate also allow with no missing evidence. Null accepted profiles also pass.
findings.fix: Resolve supported campaign scope/profile to the requested task and capability. Require action candidate, stage candidate and manifest identity to agree; require applicable profile fields rather than comparing only two present strings. Do not equate syntax with finalized settlement.

findings.title: Acceptance can replace frozen payload identity
findings.repro: changed-payload-acceptance-override changes actual design.md and only acceptance.unchangedPayloadHashes; original candidateSha256 still yields candidateCurrent=true and ALLOWED. Missing manifest inputs also passes. Revoked acceptance, null acceptance hash and missing review scope produce no unresolved evidence.
findings.fix: Require unchanged payload hashes to equal the frozen manifest. Constrain the publication bridge to its documented control path and transformation. Require supported manifest inputs, acceptance linkage and review scope; preserve contradictory existing acceptance/review evidence. This is reader consistency, not M2 review ingestion.

findings.title: Historical or incomplete accounting becomes live credit
findings.repro: budget-schema-only allows after replacing runtime snapshot with {schema:moriarty.supervised-accounting/1}. Author positive replaces historical snapshot with integer accounting. Root separately reproduced ignored full-cap planning charge, negative planning charge, null master/package caps and unknown budget key in root-positive-path-probes2.json.
findings.fix: Resolve explicit current runner state and applicable charge/cap semantics. Never derive live credit from historical reservations or integer relabeling. Missing limits, charges, authority/scope or freshness remain unavailable. Existing runner owns charging; M1 needs an adapter or injected current read, not a second ledger.

findings.title: Prerequisites are nonempty labels without supporting campaigns
findings.repro: On positive family with atomic-accept prerequisite, prerequisite-missing-campaign and prerequisite-wrong-candidate allow with no missing evidence. prerequisite-blocked-control correctly denies, establishing traversal without evidence verification.
findings.fix: For each prerequisite resolve its campaign and required acceptance/profile/candidate consistency. Transitive status traversal alone does not establish prerequisite acceptance.

findings.title: Closed schema contract remains incomplete
findings.repro: stage-admission-unknown-schema, manifest-unknown-schema, resource-unknown-schema, program-unknown-field and campaign-unknown-field all allow without missing evidence. Exact binding schema checking fixes only one boundary.
findings.fix: Implement explicit closed supported shapes and versions for every consumed boundary, including nested campaign/resource/manifest/acceptance/review records. Reject unsupported/missing fields before deriving booleans; avoid string-prefix permission checks.

findings.title: Next selection drops history provenance and does not query alternate lineages
findings.repro: Source inspection: _select_next receives six history values but omits the current operational-history gap; same-lineage candidates inherit default zeros as verified. Other lineages get operational-history without invoking available history_reader. No runtime claim beyond inspected control flow.
findings.fix: Assess each candidate with history and its provenance for that lineage, using the supplied reader. Reuse a complete validated current history result; do not lose unavailable status or rule out independent eligible repair solely because the current action has a different lineage.

limitations: Offline Python/Git disposable copies only. No source edits, model/provider CLI, network, wallet, proof, ledger submission, launch or persistence claims. All temporary copied fixtures removed. Existing accepted design scope is not SP05 implementation permission.
disposition: Second same-class admission failure: use these positive-path reproducers for concrete diagnosis and change the adapter approach before another broad correction. Establish a genuine explicit live-resource read and complete supported campaign mapping, preserve negative cases, then correct within approved M1 authority. Do not create another design packet or expand to M2 to conceal M1 defects.
